summary: Flexbox is a CSS layout, so the HTML stays plain. You only need an element to be the container and its direct children to be the items.
notes: Only direct children become flex items. The links are items of nav, not of header.
The officers are a <ul> because they are a list, even though they display as cards.
is fine here for a line break inside a short item.
pitfall: Putting display: flex on the items instead of their parent. Flexbox is turned on for the container.
